summary: 06-04 foundation: campaign_runner.py (CampaignPlan / CampaignRunner / ArtifactStore / RunSpec / RunResult / outcome_event / validate_parent) and save_lifecycle.py (backup, cloud-sync attestation, temp-verify + atomic canonical replace, post-run hash, verified restore), plus test_campaign_runner.py (30) and test_save_lifecycle.py (10). The runner validates prerequisites and events with the 06-02 schema, commits LAUNCH_INTENT to the 06-03 DurableLaunchStore before sending exactly one broker request, activates only ledger-confirmed identities (normal or reconciliation), and turns timeout, no-process, uncertain and orphan outcomes into gate-failed or campaign-blocked slots without replacing them. It enforces the arm, focus and manual-start checkpoints, confirms helper release through an external observer after the controller is terminated, writes immutable plan/stage/per-run manifests, flushes four separate streams, and stores the 06-02 reporter output unchanged.
intent: The 06-02 and 06-03 layers are the only owners of identity and launch semantics. The runner calls their public APIs (validate_prerequisites / validate_campaign_events / generate_campaign_report / DurableLaunchStore / build_launch_request) and derives every launch classification from the ledger, never from the broker response. Each authority is fixed: preflight stream for reservation and preflight events, the ledger for launch and activation events, the outcome stream for terminal events. This lets a resume after a crash rebuild state deterministically and gives the 06-02 validator one place to reject any reuse or overwrite.
notes: Stage durations and slot counts come from 06-02 STAGE_POLICIES (C0=1800s x2 ... C4=28800s x20), which differ from the 06-04 plan prose. Slot ledger ownership is bound by the launch nonce stored in ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT details. Only PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED allows re-running a stage, under a new execution id x{n+1}; the blocked chain goes into report campaign_chain. Formal plans reject ports with development_only=True. Runner tests use the real DurableLaunchStore and skip on non-Windows, like 06-03. The CLI, config and runbook (must_complete_now 15-21) are left to subtask 2; the API is in .claude/handoff-task1.md. Full suite: 1851 passed, 8 skipped (baseline 1819 + 40 new).
